name: proto-import-cycle-closed-twice
description: A file reached by two import statements of one cycle while it loads fails with the recursive-import error of the first cycle the compiler finds, and every file of the cycle publishes nothing, a schema-unparsed note naming each. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
